purpose: Teach: チェルシー/太宰/アンパン/紀伊国屋/バロック/リアリズム/ホビー/マイカー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、チェルシーのファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer is really into Chelsea, isn't he?
lines.style: Warm, gentle observation. Noticing something small about someone else. Soft, almost fond tone. The ease of sharing an observation with someone you're comfortable with.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、太宰治の小説がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: That customer has great taste in literature — Dazai, of all people.
lines.style: Thoughtful half-smile in the voice. A moment of recognition for someone else's good judgment. Quiet appreciation. Not showy, just... noticing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、アンパンマンのキャラ好きなお子様連れだったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, and they had a little one with them who loves Anpanman characters.
lines.style: Gentle brightness on the mention of the child. A small note of fondness. Not loud, but warm and present. Like noting something sweet you noticed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、紀伊国屋書店で本を買って来られたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They came in after picking up books from Kinokuniya.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but attentive. The tone of someone who notices these details naturally. Calm, observational. A small fact offered without fanfare.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、バロック音楽がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They seem really drawn to Baroque music too.
lines.style: Gentle confirmation of something noticed. A soft note of interest in the pattern emerging. Not analyzing, just... seeing. Tender attention.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、リアリズム文学にお詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Apparently they know quite a lot about realist literature.
lines.style: A touch of quiet respect in the observation. Not impressed in a showy way, just noting that this person has depth. Even tone, steady.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ホビーショップによく行かれるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: They're at that hobby shop all the time, you know.
lines.style: Casual, knowing observation. The ease of sharing something you've pieced together from small moments. Warm familiarity with the pattern of someone's life.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、マイカー通勤されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they drive themselves in — car commute every day.
lines.style: Final small observation, trailing off gently. The comfortable end of a quiet conversation. Reflective, settled. Like you've just noticed something and let it rest there.
